text: READ-ONLY CLASSIFICATION, no claim/reservation: the remaining fields are NOT all specificity-shaped. Current source partitions them: (1) uniformCoverage is an unconditional discrete leaf proportion; support is structurally total when leaves exist, and its defect is 0.0 on zero leaves, so MassRatio would add a constant rather than information. (2) importanceWeightedCoverage already abstains when no importance exists, but partial importance availability is unreported; its value denominator is weight-sum while coverage is naturally leaf availability, so it needs an explicit estimand/carrier ruling, not specificity copied over. (3) the six external masses plus distortedMass are unconditional mean-per-unit posterior masses using row count; AlignmentRow explicitly allows subnormalized rows, so replacing count with summed mass would change the estimand. Their defect is 0.0 on zero rows; they need typed absence/count receipt, not source conditioning. (4) distortedMassByFacet filters zero entries, so empty map conflates no rows with measured zero distortion. (5) perUnitLocalizability omits units with no source mass, so map-key absence conflates ineligibility/missing unit; it needs per-unit typed absence, not an aggregate ratio. Also docs/design/adr-0003-migration-status.md is materially stale: it still lists specificity/chronology/causal as Option[Double] and says specificity is next, while current source carries MassRatio. No edit made.
